commits.message:
fix(click): a refused click leaves nothing behind, and every click is answered after its landing (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.axx)

- Close no longer commits a click in flight: what a cut-off click wrote
  lands whole with its consequence, or not at all, so a refused click is
  never committed at shutdown.
- A refused click forgets only the files of the history steps it took; a
  landing names only the files its changes change.
- A landed click's reload and consequence each run, and any failure shows
  on the session's warning indicator.
- A second write to a file the click already wrote is applied over what
  the click wrote, and a contradiction is refused.
- The interpreter reads a file an earlier change removed as absent.
- The host answers a turn only after its effect-done turns, so a click is
  answered after its landing, in process or out of it.
- The renderer reads subscriptions as part of the turn, so a read that
  throws still hands on the turn's effects.

feat(click): a click's config writes are changes the host lands whole, so a refused one changes nothing (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.axx)

The renderer no longer writes a config file. A click's writes leave its
turn as `change` effects, one per file, each naming the settings it
touches and the JSON5 value it read there. The host performs a turn's
changes together or not at all, checking each setting against what was
read, so a hand edit elsewhere in the file never refuses a click and one
to the same setting always does.

What else a click did (the picks a save releases, its history step) is
its consequence: applied in the turn its changes land, after the clicking
session reloads, or dropped when they don't, with the reason on the ⚠.
A change refused because a setting moved also makes the session's history
forget that file; a write that fails for I/O keeps the step. A journal
turn opens only once the changes ahead of it have landed.
refactor(click): load-config and toolbar-toggle are deleted, so a session's config is only what its client named (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.axx)
docs(spec): A-1's open item says a request waits for the renderer's thread, not for turns taken one at a time (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.cwq) (#767)
